messages:
sara: FYI re-opening the postmortem follow-up from last week's cross-region LB churn — seeing an EVICITON loop + retries pattern again this morning in us-west -> eu-west paths. looks similar to PM: routing flaps + aggressive healthcheck backoff.
raj: ack. which pools are affected? can you paste a sample timeline?
sara: short timeline: 06:12 healthchecks spike -> 06:13 LBs start ejecting 20% of pods in eu-west -> 06:15 upstream backpressure -> 06:20 client retries + 503s.  logs: ```2026-03-17T06:12:03Z lb01 health_check FAIL backend=10.2.4.17 timeout=204ms```
jen: that's the same symptom from the March 2nd run. we had a mitigation (increase healthcheck timeout + staggered probes) in the playbook but it wasn't applied to those regional pools.
michael: is the eviction due to connection churn or TLS handshake timeouts? TLS renegotiation metrics show a small spike but not enough to explain ejections.
sara: looks like connection churn + transient auth failures from a certificatemanager job that renewed certs briefly. timeline shows cert rotate at 06:10 on eu-west-agent-3.
tara: tagging infra and certs team in case there's a rollout overlap. @raj can you own triage and confirm cert rollout correlation?
raj: runway: I'll correlate deploys and LB ejects, will check CDN and node-exporter metrics. ETA 45m.
jen: while raj triages, can we set an immediate mitigation? proposal: temporarily disable aggressive ejection policy for cross-region routes and revert to conservative thresholds for the next 2 hours.
michael: +1 for mitigation. also suggest enabling KV prefix cache to reduce inter-region chatter during degraded windows.
sara: mitigation steps: 1) update lb ejection config: `ejection_threshold: 0.5 -> 0.8` 2) extend healthcheck timeout from 200ms -> 800ms 3) annotate affected pools with `postmortem: followup-1799991234` 4) schedule canary on 2 nodes then global.
ops-bot: deploy request queued: change set id eqs-8723, target: eu-west-lb-pool, approver: raj.
raj: approved, running canary now. I'll report back at +15.
jen: action items (short): - raj: triage deploy vs cert rotate (45m) - michael: evaluate TLS handshakes + add alert if handshake_err_rate > 0.5% (3d) - tara: add playbook step to verify cert rotation windows ±5m vs LB ejection windows (2d) - sara: create follow-up doc with timeline & config diffs (EOD)
sara: noted recurring pattern: certificate churn + aggressive ejection policies -> cross-region retries. we should bake this into the routing playbook so on cert rollouts we automatically relax ejection thresholds for 10m.
jen: agree. also recording a small script to detect simultaneous cert rotations across regions and alert if >1 region rotates within 10m.
raj: can confirm canary looked good, global rollout applied at 06:32, error rates dropped to baseline by 06:38. logs show fewer ejects after `ejection_threshold` change.
sara: thanks. reopening follow-ups for tracking: owners + due dates in the postmortem board. I'll push the brief to the incidents board and ping people.
tara: adding note: if playbook change involves runtime config, ensure dedicated has same guardrails (Dedicated customers might need opt-in).
michael: filing a small eval to quantify token-level impact from enabling caching during these events — helps in Optimize recommendations.
jen: OK closing this thread after actions are on the board. if anyone sees recurrences tag `#eviction-loop` and ping oncall. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: incident-note created: INC-2026-0034 linked to postmortem-1799991234
